# Issue 6: Build the top-down layout editor

## Summary

Create a top-down editor where users can select, move, and rotate objects within visible room boundaries.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Room boundaries are visible
- [ ] Objects are selectable
- [ ] Movable objects can be dragged
- [ ] Objects can be rotated
- [ ] Fixed objects cannot be moved accidentally
- [ ] Measurements can be shown

## Notes

This phase focuses on editing interactions. Validation and suggestions come later.
